properties.title: SERVIR West Africa 2024 Training Program on Data Stewardship and the CoreTrustSeal Requirements: Session 2, R0 Requirement
properties.description: Preparing for CoreTrustSeal Certification includes a self-assessment to identify and address areas for improving the data repository and for describing how the requirements have been met when completing the application. Completing CoreTrustSeal Requirement 0 provides an opportunity to describe the data repository, generally, and to provide context for reviewers and readers.
